notes:
Gameplay
- Grabbing someone knocked down on the floor is much easier: hold grab near them and your hands go for them, bending down if they are lying down, and latch on instead of grabbing the floor.
- If the last players fall off within half a second of each other, the round is a draw.
- Lee Sin's Dragon's Rage (E) reaches a third further.
- Hecarim's Devastating Charge (E) gets to full gallop in 1s (was 1.5s).
- Sett's Haymaker (Q) winds up 25% faster: full power in 1.2s (was 1.5s), and knocks them a little up as well as back.

Lobby
- Chat in the lobby.
- The host can kick players.

Interface
- Everyone sees their ping and frame rate in a match (the host sees 0 ms); dev mode adds the rest.
- Patch notes: after an update the menu shows what changed since the version you last played (also under Patch notes in the menu).

Balance: Lee Sin's Dragon's Rage (E) knocks back 50% harder; the Sonic Wave (Q) recast kick knocks back 25% less. Singed's Fling (E) grabs from 25% further away.
Players in China connect to online games through a faster route when one is available.

After getting up from a knockout you are untouchable for 1 second (no hits, grabs or hooks) and drawn see-through.
New laughs mixed in with the Gang Beasts ones.

New champion: Lee Sin. Sonic Wave (Q) marks the first champ it hits for 3s; press Q again to fly in with a flying kick and knock them back. The cooldown starts once the mark is used or wears off, and the Q slot glows while you can recast. Dragon's Rage (E) is a roundhouse kick that knocks the champ in front back into anyone behind them.
Fix: online, your champion now turns to face where you aim instead of its arms bending backwards.

Climbing, like Gang Beasts
- Holding jump while hanging lifts you up to your hands and stops there, legs hanging (no more gliding up walls).
- Move while hanging to swing your legs, up and over your head; swing them over a ledge and let go to climb onto it.
- Let go of one hand and it reaches back up: grab again to climb hand over hand.

Gameplay
- Jumps go 25% higher.

Maps
- Trawler and Subway are lit like Gang Beasts, with its sky and ambient light.
- Subway: the camera sits closer, at Gang Beasts' angle; a stray copy of the station is gone.

Online play
- Blitz's and Vi's E now glow on your own screen when you join someone's lobby.

Everyone needs 1.15.1 to play together.

New maps
- Trawler: a fishing boat out at sea. Throw them overboard, or down the hold.
- Subway: an underground platform between two tracks.

Online play
- Gang Beasts' netcode: your walking, jumping and sprinting are instant; punches, grabs, abilities and dashes are the host's, so everyone sees the same fight even at high ping.
- Abilities land where you saw your target (the host makes up for your lag).
- Cooldowns come back on time at high ping.

Gameplay
- Punch aim assist: punches turn to the nearest enemy in front of you, like Gang Beasts.
- Sprint is slower (4.8 m/s).

Everyone needs 1.15.0 to play together.

Your ping is shown top left in a match. Much smoother play on high ping or a bad connection: other players keep moving through lag spikes instead of freezing and then jumping, your own champion gets yanked back far less when your connection stalls, and the game sends half as much data. Better connections get more responsive play too: other players are shown fresher and your inputs reach the host sooner. Dev mode: the ping line also shows fps, the slowest frame and how far behind other players are drawn.
Singed's Fling throws 30% further. Smoother movement of other players for anyone connected through the relay.

Running: double-tap a movement key and keep holding it. Singed's glue now lands where your cursor is, even right under you, with a range and target indicator. Blitzcrank's hook leaves its target stunned on their feet (dizzy stars) for 0.5s. Sett's Facebreaker can stop a dash (like Vi's Q) if you time it. Knocked-out champs slide around more easily. Vi's Q is 15% weaker and Alistar's Headbutt knockback is 25% shorter again.

Thresh's Flay hits both sides of him, with a two-sided aim indicator: aim at enemies to throw them behind you, aim away to push them off. Abilities show as disabled while you're stuck in Singed's glue. Blitzcrank's hook leaves its target limp for 0.5s after the pull. Alistar's Headbutt knockback is 25% shorter. Hecarim's Rampage cooldown is 3s (was 4s).

Thresh: the hook now holds its target helpless for the whole chain, pressing Q again flies you all the way to them, and he has a new look (soul-fire head, iron shoulders and chains). Singed: glue only affects enemies, and stops them using abilities while they're in it.

Two new champions. Thresh: Q Death Sentence hooks a champ, tugs them toward you and chains you together for 2s (press Q again to leap to them); E Flay throws everyone in a line over and behind you. Singed: Q Mega Adhesive lobs a glue puddle that slows champs and stops them jumping; E Fling throws the champ next to you over your head.
Alistar's Headbutt: hold E to aim it with your mouse, let go to lunge that way.

New champion: Alistar. Q Pulverize launches everyone around him; E Headbutt knocks a champ far back, much further if they're still in the air. Much less rubber-banding online, especially on long-distance or lossy connections, and players who can't connect directly now get a fast relay. Holding each other no longer makes you float. Switch champion from the Esc menu (takes effect next round). Hecarim knockback +25%.

Grabbing another player online no longer rubber-bands, floats or teleports. Smoother movement on 120-200 ms connections. Sett Q: +50% power, and punches can no longer interrupt the windup (only a knockout can). Hecarim E: no aim indicator; press to charge, press again to stop.

- Fixed bouncing in and out of the floor (and falling through it) when playing on someone else's lobby with high ping
- In-match chat: press T (rebindable in Controls), Enter to send, Esc to cancel
- Lobby codes are now 3 characters
- Gang Beasts stages (Girders, Rooftop, Incinerator) run about twice as fast
- Practice: you no longer respawn on top of someone
- Vi Q: once fully wound up you can hold it for 3 more seconds
- Online: everyone needs this version to play together

- Sett Q reworked: no more Grit. Hold Q to lock your aim at the cursor and wind up: the longer you hold, the further (2-5 m) and harder it hits. Everyone sees the cone fill. Catches champs right beside him; a miss only whooshes
- Vi Q: the aim strip grows with the windup to show how far she'll dash
- Vi E: a smoke blast shows the champs behind the target getting shoved
- The mouse stays inside the game window during matches, with a new crosshair cursor (Esc frees it)
- Online: everyone needs this version to play together

- Incinerator: darker room lit by the pit, steady warm light over the whole stage, embers rising from the pit
- Pit glows evenly to its edges; bloom stays tight around it
- Much less bloom on players (eyes, champion glows, shiny highlights)
- Team belt only shows in team matches
- Update screen shows the new version number while downloading

- **Aim with your mouse:** hold Q or E to aim Rocket Grab, Devastating Charge or Vault Breaker at your cursor (only you see the aim line), then let go to cast
- **Incinerator:** you no longer spawn over the pit; the conveyor belts slowly roll you toward the fire; the pit glows and spits lava, and its firelight lights up the room
- **Lighting:** shadows and bloom are closer to Gang Beasts' on every stage
Fixes 1.6.0's menu not responding and the missing game preview in the background (a file was missing from the installer).

- **New look:** redesigned menus, lobby, HUD, pause and update screens, with a new crest logo
- **UI sounds:** quiet, subtle UI sounds; the menu music is gone
- **Lift and throw:** while grabbing someone, hold Shift (or click in the left stick) to lift them overhead, then let go to throw them
- **Climbing:** while hanging from a ledge, hold jump to push yourself up, then push toward the ledge to roll over it
- **Stages:** new stage, Incinerator; Ring and Lighthouse are removed
- **Performance:** about 3x higher frame rate, plus Gang Beasts' own map lighting
- **Ragdolls:** limbs no longer fold through the body
- **Sett:** Haymaker shows its hit area while it charges

- Much less rubberbanding: the host no longer drops late inputs (fast moves like Hecarim's charge, and getting hit, now stay in sync), and corrections glide instead of snapping.
- Abilities are back on Q / E, and every control can be rebound from the main menu (click a key, press the new one; Esc cancels, Backspace clears).
- Three new maps from Gang Beasts: Rooftop, Ring and Lighthouse. Girders also gained its grabbable bars.
- Updates install and relaunch much faster (the game is now 20 files instead of ~1,900). This first update to 1.5.0 still has to remove the old files, so it is the slow one.

**Smoother online play, especially for players who aren't hosting or have high ping.**

- Your inputs now reach the host in a fixed order and timing, so your champion no longer gets pulled back (rubberbanding) when the connection is jittery.
- Other players move on the host's clock with a buffer that adapts to your connection, instead of stuttering when updates arrive unevenly.
- Motion is smooth on screens faster than 60Hz (host too).
- While knocked out or hooked you see your body exactly where the host has it, instead of it jerking around.

**Controls now match Gang Beasts.** Each mouse button is one hand: tap to punch with it, hold to reach out and grab with it (in the air a held hand grabs straight away, for ledges). J / K do the same. Abilities moved to **X** and **C**; lie down is **Left Ctrl**. On a gamepad the triggers/bumpers are your hands, X/Y abilities, B lie down, A jump, right stick click headbutt.

- **Punches** are a proper swing now: the arm cocks back, then hooks round while the shoulders turn into it, instead of shooting straight out. Arms no longer twist at the shoulder. Regular punches knock back less.
- **Grabbing walls** and other solid things no longer shoves you into the floor.
- **Sett:** Haymaker hits 50% harder.
- **Hecarim:** Rampage spins once (half as long).

**Less lag for high-ping players.** Your own champion now moves and swings instantly on your screen; the host still decides hits and knockouts and your game quietly lines itself up with the host.

- **Hecarim:** Devastating Charge builds up speed instead of starting at full gallop, and hits harder the faster you're going. Press E again to stop it. Rampage now works while walking or mid-charge.
- **Sett:** Haymaker (Q) is powered by Grit. Getting hit fills the bar over his head, and it drains out of combat. Hold Q to plant and charge, then let go for a cone punch as strong as the Grit you spent. Facebreaker shows its reach on the ground and stuns (longer if you catch champs on both sides). New vest.
- **Rocket Grab:** a hooked champ goes limp and can't fight back until the pull ends.
- Spawn points are random every round.
- **Controls:** holding Ctrl to lie down while pressing W no longer closes the game. Headbutt is now F or middle click (H still works). The cursor is hidden during matches unless the Esc menu is open.

Relay fallback for players who can't connect directly (strict NAT, mainland China).

- Joining now tries a direct connection, then automatically switches to a relay server if that fails.
- Tick **Use relay** in the menu to skip the direct attempt and join through the relay straight away.
- Network test now also checks the relay.

New champions Vi (Q Vault Breaker, E Relentless Force) and Sett (Q Haymaker, E Facebreaker). 2.5s stun immunity after waking from a knockout. Menu: Network test + Copy network log - if you can't connect, run the test, copy the log and send it over. Extra STUN servers that work from mainland China.

Climbing (hang with grab, Space to climb), headbutt (H / pad B), lie down (hold C / pad Y), loose GB-style arms that fling when you spin, momentum punches (hold punch to keep the arm out), volume slider, Hecarim hooves, quieter sounds.
First release.
